findings.title: Document the build-time requirement for custom images
findings.body: Enabling `rolling-updates` in the CR is not sufficient for an optimized custom Keycloak image: the feature must also be included when building the image, as shown by the added `--features=rolling-updates` in `operator/scripts/Dockerfile-custom-image`. Without that build-time setting, the operator can pass the CR feature at runtime but the image may reject the changed build-time configuration or lack the feature. Document this requirement here so custom-image users can configure the image as well as the CR.
